method: Batchmode offscreen material-id pass (Hidden/Suborned/MaterialId072): every (material, layer) of the scene drawn in its own 24-bit colour into a 1920x1080 float target from the play camera at each play view (ortho 14, pitch 38, Baseline072's poses); post, SSAO and fog off, non-mesh renderers off, the snapshot crowd hidden; the architecture fade's dithered cut kept on materials whose shader cuts, alpha-test maps kept. `share` = pixels / frame pixels. `all` draws every material opaque (glass and other transparent surfaces cover what is behind them); `opaqueOnly` drops transparent materials (renderQueue >= 2500), so what stands behind glass counts instead. Not UnityStats; GPU Resident Drawer off.
maps: kind: textured = a colour map bigger than 8x8 bound (_BaseMap or _MainTex); swatch-atlas = Suborned/FacadeLit's facade-atlas (Atlas.cs: 16x16 point-sampled cells, one flat colour per cell: flat colour for 072-F); flat = no colour map (or a map of 8x8 or less). maps lists every bound texture property.
